source.title: Call for Applicants - WCA Competition Announcement Team Members (March 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) is seeking new members! The application is open to any community member, but please review the expected tasks and qualities.

<!-- break -->

### What does the WCAT do?

The official rights and duties of the WCAT are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2024.2](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf).

The tasks of a WCAT member include:

- Review and announce competitions around the world on a daily basis with accuracy and attention to detail.
- Handle change requests to competitions.
- Engage in frequent discussions and voting within the Team.
- Make and communicate changes to the WCA Competition Requirements Policy.

### Requirements
Applicants are expected to possess the following qualities:

- Proactive personality, detail-oriented, and solution-oriented mindset.
- Fluency in English.
- Availability on-call throughout the day to engage in time-sensitive discussions 
- Availability for about 30 minutes, several times per week to work on competition announcements or changes.
- Good familiarity with the [WCA Competition Requirements Policy (WCRP)](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf) and the WCA competition organizer role.
- Communication and/or policy-writing skills are not required but are strongly encouraged.
- Be at least 16 years of age as of April 5th, 2025.

### How to apply
Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

- A brief personal introduction.
- Summary of activities done for the WCA.
- A concrete overview on how expected qualities are to be fulfilled.
- (Optional) Indicate whether you would like to join our documentation sub-team. This team works on updates to the WCA Competition Requirements Policy and other public information about WCAT policies.
- (Optional) Qualities and qualifications you find relevant that are not listed above.

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until April 5th, 2025 23:59 UTC to Zeke Mackay (zmackay@worldcubeassociation.org).

translation.title: WCA 比赛公告团队成员招募（2025 年 3 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 比赛公告团队（WCAT）正在招募新成员！社区成员均可申请，但请先了解工作内容与要求。

<!-- break -->

### WCAT 的工作是什么？

WCAT 的正式权利和职责见 [WCA 决议 10.2024.2](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf)。

WCAT 成员的工作包括：

- 日常审核并公布世界各地的比赛，认真核对细节，确保准确。
- 处理比赛信息的修改申请。
- 经常参与团队内部的讨论和投票。
- 修改《WCA 比赛要求政策》，并传达相关变更。

### 申请要求

我们希望申请人具备以下条件：

- 做事主动、注重细节，愿意寻找解决办法。
- 英语流利。
- 全天中能随时抽空参与有时效要求的讨论。
- 每周能够抽出数次、每次约 30 分钟，处理比赛公告或信息变更。
- 熟悉《[WCA 比赛要求政策（WCRP）](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf)》及 WCA 比赛组织者的工作。
- 沟通及政策写作能力不作硬性要求，但非常欢迎具备这些能力的申请人。
- 截至 2025 年 4 月 5 日已满 16 周岁。

### 如何申请

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

- 简短的自我介绍。
- 为 WCA 所做工作的总结。
- 具体说明自己如何满足上述要求。
- （可选）说明是否有意加入文档小组。该小组负责更新《WCA 比赛要求政策》及其他公开的 WCAT 政策资料。
- （可选）上述未列出、但你认为与岗位有关的能力和资历。

申请期为即日起至 2025 年 4 月 5 日 23:59 UTC。请将申请材料发送给 Zeke Mackay（zmackay@worldcubeassociation.org）。
